canonical_text: Young travelers are not one single market. Women aged 29 and under still showed strong interest in famous tourist places, at about 45%. Gourmet travel was even higher, at about 52%. This is not the same picture as the male interest in solo and hobby-based trips. The useful lesson is not that sightseeing is ending. Different young travelers may be looking for different kinds of value from the same holiday.
